theorem harmonic_closedBall_mean_value {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hu : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd u (Metric.closedBall a r)) :
    let τ : MeasureTheory.Measure (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) :=
      (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).toSphere
    (∫ ζ : Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1,
      u (a + r • (ζ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) ∂((τ Set.univ)⁻¹ • τ)) = u a

definition_audit.harmonicity: Actual Mathlib HarmonicOnNhd uses local C2 and neighborhood-zero Euclidean Laplacian. HarmonicAt is open, giving a common open neighborhood of the closed ball; no fake predicate or fallback object.
definition_audit.surface_measure: Literal Euclidean volume.toSphere on the unit-sphere subtype, normalized by its total mass. Its finite nonzero mass and identification with the source normalized surface law must be justified from n>=2 and existing canonical measure facts, not assumed.
definition_audit.integral: Actual Bochner integral over the normalized sphere. The proof must discharge integrability, not rely on its totalized zero value.
definition_audit.dimension_routes: Both the source n>2 fundamental-solution and n=2 logarithm routes remain in the source graph. No arbitrary-dimensional conclusion may be inferred from the complex-plane theorem.
